records.name: Schattenwart Wirklichso
records.biography_en: Can make a small object cast an impressively complete explanation. His HyperNorm screen turns a little cutout into the whole permitted world. A dissonant card asks what is holding the stick. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Gegenstand wurde seiner Erklärung entsprechend vergrößert.

variant_notes.note_en: Can make a small object cast an impressively complete explanation.

records.name: Idealwart Makellos
records.biography_en: Disapproves of every example for failing to be the idea. His golden sphere condemns every HyperNorm example for being an example. A dissonant card enjoys the small dent his inspection overlooked. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Vorbild bedauert die Existenz seiner Ausführungen.

variant_notes.note_en: Disapproves of every example for failing to be the idea.

records.name: Gefangener Zweifach
records.biography_en: Has been told he is not alone and would like to inspect the arrangement. His HyperNorm cuffs promise shared confinement while the spare cuff waits empty. A dissonant card asks whether company and captivity need the same chain. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Paarverhältnis ist einseitig bereits vollständig eingerichtet.

variant_notes.note_en: Has been told he is not alone and would like to inspect the arrangement.

records.name: König Schlussendlich
records.biography_en: Has considered every objection that reached him in an approved form. His closed HyperNorm book contains every objection allowed to reach the crown. A dissonant card knocks without first requesting a page number. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Einwände wurden bis zum zugelassenen Umfang erwogen.

variant_notes.note_en: Has considered every objection that reached him in an approved form.

records.name: Sophistin Glattweg
records.biography_en: Can make either side sound like the room's original intention. Her horn makes every HyperNorm position sound like the obvious common ground. A dissonant card asks why the ground moves when she speaks. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Einigkeit lässt sich mit passendem Ansatz darstellen.

variant_notes.note_en: Can make either side sound like the room's original intention.

records.name: Fackelführerin Vielleichtdort
records.biography_en: Shows the way while privately hoping the way has noticed. Her torch leads HyperNorm neighbours toward a route she cannot promise. A dissonant card walks beside her rather than demanding certainty. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Weg ist beleuchtet, nicht abschließend belegt.

variant_notes.note_en: Shows the way while privately hoping the way has noticed.
